title: Outbreak Investigation: Epidemic Curve and Attack Rate
subject: PSM
preview: Outbreak investigation establishes whether cases exceed expectation and defines a case consistently.
quickRevision: Outbreak investigation establishes whether cases exceed expectation and defines a case consistently.
An attack rate compares new cases in a defined exposed population during the event.
Hypotheses should be tested with appropriate epidemiologic methods, environmental findings and laboratory evidence.

sections.title: Recognize the core pattern
points: Outbreak investigation establishes whether cases exceed expectation and defines a case consistently.

points: An apparent cluster can result from changed testing or reporting, so verify the baseline.

quiz.question: What does an epidemic curve primarily display?
